horoscopes.horoscope: You are creative, and today you will prove to be resourceful and thereby successful! Okay, you are ambitious, says Ganesha, but don’t bite off more than you can chew. Be confident of your abilities, work hard and have faith in providence. Your intellectual talk may evoke carnal desires in your partner, and the evening may end with a steamy interlude. You are in the adventurous mood. You may want to play something funny and exciting that gives you the real pleasure. This day is perfect to get in touch with your long forgotten pals to renew the friendship bond. Full of beans, make the most of your abilities and exuberance to resolve complex issues on the personal as well as professional front. Today you are not likely to have any major financial windfall, expects Ganesha, but your mind will be active about earning more money so you may have big plans on your mind. Today’s astral configuration gives you a good chance to perform well with softwares. Though you will keep up your natural speed to finish tasks, you may not reach the desired conclusion but will learn a lot on the way, foresees Ganesha.

You will feel the burden of financial responsibilities on your shoulders today, says Ganesha. Do not let expenses bother you. Money will come to you from unexpected sources later in the day. If you can maintain an impartial judgement, then you will yield wonderful results on the financial front, advises Ganesha. Spending a quiet evening with your darling will rejuvenate your senses, so just soak in the good times, says Ganesha. You would be in a mood to get caught in a memorable selfie with your sweetheart at a private pool. Your trust with your loved one will be broadened. Today will be devoted to money matters and family affairs. In the pink of health, you shall hardly get tired and also enjoy your humdrum routine. Both personal and professional tasks will be accomplished swiftly and easily. Keep it up! You will be getting an opportunity to earn money through dual sources today, feels Ganesha. Your stability and security oriented mind will try to grab both or multiple opportunities. Today’s planetary alignment gives extra boost to your vocal chords. In fact, you excellent communication skills will make sure that all your work is done in a jiffy. Even important meetings will be fruitful. Your decision-making ability in the important matters might ease the risk of the top authority.

You are extremely competitive. And it doesn’t matter how far behind the competition is. So today, you will continue your usual quest for getting better. You won’t have it any other way as you despise mediocrity. You will find yourself in the company of like-minded people who will inspire you to study new subjects. The day is equally rewarding for your love life. You will be tickled pink when your lover responds to your moves in a way that surprises you. You might help your lover socialize so that he or she forgets all worries and pains. You will be in a very good mood and your energy level will be very high. However, you should avoid distributing your energy into too many tasks. Besides, you should find time for yourself rather than spending all your energy in work. You may not be able to earn extra money but you will be satisfied with the sources of your earning. The more you connect with the people, richer you will become, points out Ganesha. The renewed energy that today’s planetary alignment blesses you with is surely going to keep you buoyant throughout the day, foresees Ganesha. Latest trends will be the topic of discussion in the office. Participating in creative brainstorming will be the event of the day, foresees Ganesha.

Your business acquaintances will come forward in the manner that may seem nothing short of some divine intervention. This means that they will virtually save your neck from the guillotine, predicts Ganesha. You will grow wiser in your spending ways, as you will know what to buy and what not to buy. At work, you will impress everyone with your skills and efficiency. ‘Don’t leave, but live a little’- whisper in your loved one’s ear and see it will work like magic. Understanding your past mistakes and reuniting with your loved one will be on the cards. Your loved one will apologize you if you are in true love, feels Ganesha. You must not take up physically heavy or difficult tasks today. You should instead try light activities today. Ganesha feels that heavier load may affect you physically. Besides, your logical calculations and people may not go right. There are chances that you may spend money on the opposite sex and long distance trips. It’s good if you are able to manage this, but there is little likelihood of you not spending at all. The day is yours to conquer. Your camera-eye memory will make you a star in office. Making tough calculations is like child’s play for you, and you’d do that with infinite ease today. Your smarter, steadier and sharper attitude will catch everyone’s attention, feels Ganesha.

Che Guevara may not hold the beacon any more, and the best of the Beatles are long gone. But your desire to revolutionise the world is as strong as ever, sees Ganesha. The best ideas are the ones that come suddenly and subconsciously. So, always carry a pen and paper with you, you may need them to note down ideas that you generate over the course of the day. Remember, ideas have a tendency to wane with the same speed with which they wax. Never let one pass by, it may just be the answer you have been searching for. You might be in a joyous mood to fill excitement in your partner. Being loyal to your loved one will be well appreciated by your sweetheart and his or her family. Expect a family union or get together in the evening. Your good mood today will also make you feel healthier. Besides, you will be communicating with large group of people and you will leave an impact on the people with whom you contact. Health wise, Ganesha does not foresee any problem. You stars are favouring you and you may see an increase in your earnings. You should not let this opportunity go in vain and must make the most of this day, says Ganesha. Today, your diplomatic skills will make you an instant hit at the workplace. Sharing intellectual knowledge with someone you adore will help you sharpen your wits. Your sincere and serious mindset will win many complex situations and help you fetch admiration from colleagues, feels Ganesha.

Professionalism will be overshadowed by personal preoccupations. Drill your way out of problems today by meeting them head-on. Don’t get stuck up on the emotional front, especially in the evening, cautions Ganesha. All is not well on the love front, says Ganesha. Fussing and fuming over trivial issues can ignite arguments that may send chances of reconciliation up in flames. Sorting out the important matters related to heart will be in trouble, foresees Ganesha. It’s a good day from health point of view. Besides, You will be trying to think more loudly about issues that you have to address. Today, you should take up mentally tiring and exhausting tasks but you should not take physical load much. In order to make financial gains, you will need to maintain very good rapport with your friends, business associates and bosses. All those with whom you are related via work can benefit you in a big way. Today, nothing seems more important to you than your career. You will be focused, patient and dedicated to your routine work. Workload will occupy your full day. Don’t upset your boss by ignoring new tasks, which you ought to finish today.

Trivialities should be the least of your concerns today. Do not let the small things faze you out. Remember that it is the overall picture that matters, and not one small stroke of the brush. Bear this is mind, since you may come under some pressure from subordinates at your workplace. Just remember to consider all possibilities before making any decisions. Also, take time to relax and maybe even meditate. It is the key to finding some peace of mind on this hectic day, reminds Ganesha. You might tend to judge your sweetheart on certain matters and give your straightforward opinion. Nothing is perfect in life. You must avoid being too sensitive in your love life, suggests Ganesha. Remember, too much of anything is bad, even if it’s too much mush! Ganesha feels that it’s going to be a good day if you wish to relax or go out for some entertainment. Relaxation often increases energy levels. This is a good time to plan trips and enjoy good time with friends or family members. You won’t be overspending today but at the same time, you won’t be earning much either. You believe in balance and seeing balance in the balance-sheet will make you feel at ease, feels Ganesha. Today, you’d be in the right frame of mind to design a smashing software. And just when you’re giving the finishing touches, you may have to get busy making travel plans or placing long-distance calls to colleagues working in overseas branches, foresees Ganesha.

Work pressure will keep on mounting today, predicts Ganesha. But you shall handle it with great style, all thanks to your patience. But keep a watch on the radar and learn how to spot stress early and then act on it as quickly as you can. Be ready to get a surprise and woo your lover. You will be able to steal the attention of your partner tonight. Your sharp penetrative looks and ultra sexy get up will make the night steamy, playful, and passionate, feels Ganesha. You should avoid negative people today. This is very important as your planetary transits are adverse. At the same time, you should take support from good, positive persons. This way you can also stay positive and not get affected adversely. You will not be very happy with your financial standing today. However, you should not allow negative thoughts to dominate you. Positive and optimistic thinking can do wonders for you, feels Ganesha. Get ready to face a barrage of routine activities and projects in the office today. Work your way through it diligently, without losing yourself in the maze, advises Ganesha. Taking sharp and shrewd decisions over critical projects will prove your guts, feels Ganesha.

Look before you leap, says Ganesha. Cupid has strung his bow and aimed an arrow at you. Love’s labour will easily aid you to woo a young, tender heart. But don’t be swept away by easy prospects and guard your reputation at all costs. You would be in no mood to argue with your partner, thereby agreeing to everything he or she says. You will bring a pleasant surprise for your loved one. You want to make your sweetheart happy and satisfied. Exploring a different cuisine might be a good idea for you, feels Ganesha. Ganesha feels that while you will be doing so much for others, you should see to it that you take good care of yourself. Your emotions may want you to make great efforts for others but you should only do as much as your energy permits. The more you make use of your contacts, more you will be benefited, says Ganesha. By and large, this is going to be a mixed day with both expenses and opportunity to earn more money. Hard work and tough time is ahead of you, predicts Ganesha. Don’t forget to make quick visits to the canteen to gulp down glasses of fresh lime soda to regain lost energy. In such a state, it’s best to stay away from working on technical projects, feels Ganesha.

You will starve for some free time, but will find it difficult to steal even a minute from your busy schedule, even if it is for unwinding your overworked soul, says Ganesha. In times like these, one can hardly think straight, let alone be innovative. You will, however, work your way out by prioritising matters. By the end of the day, your efforts may get paid off, leaving you with the thought that it was all worthwhile after all!. There might be differences in views, opinions or lifestyle with your partner. Understanding your loved one and learning some interesting things will be the keys to managing your stress better. Laugh, love and live with your partner are the healthy options. Ganesha feels that there will be tasks of various nature that you will have to handle so you will need enough mental ability for the same. You need to be in touch with encouraging people. Besides, you should eat healthy food to maintain good health. It will be very difficult for you to discriminate between essential and non-essential today. Thus, you will find it difficult to control expenses. By and large, its going to be an average day for money matters. You’ve got stiff competition in office today. A colleague who’s been raring to lock horns with you will make the first move, says Ganesha. Be on your vigil and control your temper. Else you might find yourself pinned against the wall.

You find solace in travel today. But if you plan to include others, beware, as you may end up doing all their dirty work too. But, you will find fulfillment even in that, which, says Ganesha, is your strong point. You know how to turn a weakness into strength. Ganesha foresees that you are likely to pick up a fight with your partner. Stay away from controversies and old issues. It may sour your ties with your lover. Sweeten your romance by giving your lover a gentle kiss, hug or his/her favorite food, suggests Ganesha. Today, you should think less about things that you are not directly connected with. Over-thinking about others will also impact your health adversely, feels Ganesha. You will be focussing more on multitasking today and handling too many things at once would be possible. The day is very favourable for selling out property that you own or selling an old vehicle. You are likely to get a good price for whatever you sell and make financial gains. Ganesha feels that you will be so charged up today that your foul temper may give way to mood swings, making it tough for others to handle you. Engage in some sort of multitasking that keeps you neck-deep in work, suggests Ganesha.

Today just might be the day when you invent a better mousetrap. However, your ideas have a propensity to wane and wax at the same speed, says Ganesha. Hence, keep a notebook handy to jot down all your earth-shattering revolutionary ideas. You might coin a romantic idea and your loved one will execute it. After all, you’ll meet him or her with a bottle of champagne and lots of touchy-feely love! You might discover a utopia made of love. You might even be lost in the world of fantasy. You will be able to remain in good health today despite all these ups and downs. You may be spending more time behind convincing yourself for many things and will try to apply logic on the same. This may stress your emotions a bit. It is the ideal time to research on which house or vehicle to buy. However, the final decision can be taken at a later stage. Ganesha feels that the day is not good for buying. Chalking out a detailed POA (Plan of Action) will be your top priority today. You’ve realised that you perform better if you have an outline of your day’s tasks in hand. At the end of this exercise, you’ll feel a sense of satisfaction of having achieved something.
